title: PostgreSQL Production Monitoring
description: PostgreSQL health, throughput, cache, locks, storage and replication via postgres_exporter.

panels.title: PostgreSQL
panels.description: pg_up = 1 means the exporter can reach PostgreSQL. Shows the worst instance in the selection.

panels.title: Exporter Scrape
panels.description: Prometheus scrape success for the exporter target.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since last postmaster start. Red/orange means a recent restart.

panels.title: Rollback Ratio
panels.description: Share of transactions that rolled back. Sustained spikes usually indicate application errors.

panels.title: Temp Bytes / sec
panels.description: Sorts/hashes spilling to disk. Consider raising work_mem or tuning queries.

panels.title: Sessions by State
panels.description: 'idle in transaction' that keeps growing is a classic sign of leaking connections or long-held locks.

panels.title: Longest Transaction Age
panels.description: Requires pg_stat_activity_max_tx_duration (default postgres_exporter collector). Long transactions block vacuum.

panels.title: Tuples Read
panels.description: A large returned/fetched gap suggests sequential scans — look for missing indexes.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname",datname!~"template0|template1"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname",datname!~"template0|template1"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname",datname!~"template0|template1"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

panels.title: Growth Rate (per hour)
panels.description: Bytes added per hour. Use for capacity planning.

panels.title: Disk Fill Forecast (7d)
panels.description: Linear projection of database size 7 days ahead, based on the last 6 hours.

panels.title: Checkpoints
panels.description: Lots of 'requested' checkpoints means max_wal_size is too small. (On PG17+, metrics move to pg_stat_checkpointer_*.)

panels.title: Replication Lag
panels.description: Only populated on replicas / when the replication collector is enabled.
